cohort: Women with a history of a live birth undergoing autologous, frozen-thawed single euploid embryo transfers
finding: A previous cesarean delivery was associated with a 48% reduction in the odds of implantation and a 39% reduction in the odds of an ongoing pregnancy and live birth.
mod_finding: A previous cesarean delivery was associated with a marked reduction in implantation and ongoing pregnancy and live birth in patients undergoing a single euploid embryo transfer.
